chapter: Alice Zeno: languages and the King household
title: Learning French as a child with the Mazzaro family
summary: Alice was raised among the Mazzaro family who spoke only French to her for four or five years.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was interested to know how you learned all of the different languages you speak, where you went to school first, and then how you learned your French and German and all?

Well, French, I learned the French, you see, with the people my mother, when I was born, my mother was working, and as soon as she could go back on the job, she took me and the Miss Mazzaro. They had me in the house like a child, a white child. They didn't want my mother to have anything to do with me. And they spoke nothing but French to me.

And I was fully four, five years that I spoke nothing but French. I didn't know nothing, no Creole, no other language but French. That's how I got it so, so good. And I kept on with the Frenchmen, kept on, because I liked French. Then I worked with the Gascon too.
